bio:
Thomas Jr. (1787-1830) was cut out in the 1826 codicil for 'interference and bad conduct'; his share went to his son Wesley. Possibly the War of 1812 private recorded on his father's grave marker.

FamilySearch gives Thomas Jr. the dates 19 Aug 1787 to 17 Jul 1830 and has him marrying Mary Boston (1791-1882) at Sunbury in 1807. His children were born in Plymouth and Jackson Twps between 1814 and 1822. He appears in the 1830 census, and his father's probate file is attached ([R4-S1]).
